messages:
Liz (curation): FYI folks — start of intake for mirrorwave-3b (open). quick summary: license looks permissive but has attribution clause; model size ~3.1B; initial perf run on staging shows tail latency blips. can owner check?
Mike (runtime): I ran the basic perf sweep this morning. median p99 ≈ 780ms for 512 tokens, expected ~300-400 for similar 3b models. suspect attention kernel mismatch + missing quant profile. logs: `run_2026-03-17.log` shows KV cache thrash.
Owen (mlinfra): pinged infra — allocator config for that VM series has 8GB less shared mem than our default, could explain KV swapping. I can spin a job with the higher shm but need owner sign-off.
Liz (curation): @Mike @Owen thanks. Owner for manifest + canary? I'm tentatively assigning to Mike but can transfer. Also legal check: @Priya can you confirm if attribution clause triggers any hosting restrictions?
Priya (legal): Brief read: attribution required in downstream UI and docs, but doesn't ban hosted inference. Need to confirm attribution wording for Dedicated/Private SLAs though. Will send a short summary by EOD. :ok_hand:
catalog-bot: mirrorwave-3b added tag `needs-legal` and `perf-investigate` by Liz
Carla (product): FYI product ask — if attribution is required we need a UI plan for crediting the author, plus marketing needs it on the model detail page. not a blocker for canary but heads up.
Mike (runtime): Quick repro commands I used:```bash
# run perf sweep
python perf_sweep.py --model mirrorwave-3b --seq 512 --batch 8 --trials 20
```Output snippet: `p50 220ms p90 430ms p99 780ms`
Mike (runtime): Proposed next steps: 1) Owen try job with increased shm 2) I push a quant-profile draft (int8) and small manifest change 3) legal note from Priya 4) set a 24h canary window if perf stabilizes
Owen (mlinfra): I can kick the shm job now if Mike pushes the perf job config to the `mirrorwave-3b` folder. give me the path or ping me when done.
Liz (curation): Mike — can you drop the manifest diff here? small reminder: manifest must include `license: <spdx>` and `attribution: <rendering_text>` fields.
Mike (runtime): Dropping a minimal manifest diff:```diff
diff --git a/manifest.yaml b/manifest.yaml
@@
+license: CC-BY-4.0
+attribution: "MirrorWave by OpenSynth — please credit in app footer"
+quant_profiles:
+  - name: int8-fast
+    note: draft, needs perf validation
```
Mike (runtime): also opened a PR: https://git.redwood/mirrorwave/PR-142 (small lint fixes + quant profile). please review when you can.
Liz (curation): @Priya once you confirm hosting OK, we'll un-block the PR. @Carla I'll coordinate the UI copy with you after the legal blurb.
Priya (legal): Quick follow-up: hosting is allowed but attribution must be "visible in the user-facing output or model card" — I'll add exact text. no export/usage limits found.
Carla (product): great. For UI let's aim for model card + small footer line on first use. I'll draft a microcopy after Priya's wording.
Mike (runtime): I kicked a perf run on the larger-shm worker; first results look better: `p50 210ms p90 360ms p99 420ms` — looks promising. I'll post full numbers in PR.
Liz (curation): awesome — once PR approved we'll schedule canary: target Monday 09:00 UTC, 24h, with metric checks for p99 and error-rate < 0.5%. Owners: Mike (runtime) for perf, Priya (legal) for copy, Carla (product) for UI, Owen (mlinfra) for infra.
Owen (mlinfra): noted. I'll prepare rollback playbook and a cheap smoke Canary job.
catalog-bot: Canary scheduled by Liz for 2026-03-22T09:00Z (24h) — labels updated: `canary-scheduled`
Liz (curation): final ask — @everyone add a one-line blocking comment on PR if you need extra time; otherwise I'll merge at 08:30 UTC if approvals are present. :calendar:
